# Design Specification — Democracia Colaborativa

- **Aesthetic Profile**: `modern` (Flagship Web & Editorial Research Launch Standard)
- **Structural Archetype**: `editorial-launch`
- **Palette Preset**: `daylight-editorial (Daylight Editorial (blog.google Gemini Launch reference))`

---

## 1. Typography Contract

| Role | Font Family | Fluid Scale | Tracking & Numeric Rules |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Flagship Display | `Space Grotesk`, `Fraunces`, sans-serif | `clamp(2.1rem, 5.5vw, 5.1rem)` | `letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 1.02` |
| Stage Headings | `Space Grotesk` / `Fraunces` | `clamp(1.65rem, 3.2vw, 3rem)` | `letter-spacing: -0.028em; line-height: 1.08` |
| UI & Narrative Copy | `Plus Jakarta Sans`, `DM Sans`, sans-serif | `clamp(0.98rem, 0.94rem + 0.18vw, 1.1rem)` | `line-height: 1.62` |
| Telemetry & Benchmarks | `DM Sans`, `Plus Jakarta Sans`, sans-serif | `clamp(0.72rem, 0.7rem + 0.08vw, 0.78rem)` | `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums` |

Do not use `JetBrains Mono` or coding monospace fonts for UI controls, kickers, badges, or narrative text.

---

## 2. Structural, Contrast & Restraint Contract

1. **Rhythmic Section Alternation**: Consecutive sections must never repeat identical uniform column grids. Alternate across:
   - Full-bleed interactive hero stage
   - Asymmetric 12-column Bento matrix (`span-7` + `span-5`, `span-4` + `span-8`)
   - Pinned split-screen scrollytelling walkthrough (`5fr` scrolling steps / `7fr` sticky stage)
   - Precision comparison table or split-stage workbench
2. **Information Restraint & Spaciousness**:
   - Limit cards (`.bento-cell` / `.bento-card`) to at most `3` concise elements (Title, 1–2 line summary, single action or metric) with `>= 1.5rem` internal padding.
   - Never apply thick colored `border-left` stripes to cards or nest bordered containers inside bordered containers.
3. **Navigation Without Collisions or `.hidden` Tabs**:
   - Sparse product flagships use `.floating-pill-nav` (`<= 4` items, high-opacity backdrop).
   - Dense interactive apps and catalogs MUST use a full-width sticky `.workbench-topbar` (never float a capsule over scrolling filter toolbars or card grids).
   - Editorial launches use `.chapter-progress` with live scroll tracking.
4. **Scoped Inverse Contrast**: Any dark `.carbon-breakout` or `[data-surface="dark"]` section embedded on a light canvas MUST override `--ink-primary`, `--ink-secondary`, `--ink-muted`, and `--specular-border` locally so contrast stays `>= 7:1` in every palette.
5. **Sober Visual Discipline**: Zero emojis, zero gratuitous badge/pill clusters; rely on typography, structural hairlines, and crisp vector/tabular telemetry.
